$comment: The TINSHELL app manifest — single source of truth for the tinshell-host distributor. The four lazy apps export their unmount under the ALIAS name 'unmount' (export { unmountX as unmount }), so the 'unmount' value here is the actual module export, not a convention. polkit exports no css (zero windows, no stylesheet). 'unit' = DEV systemd unit (promptd/portal/polkit only). 'lazy' = on-demand desktop app (loaded eagerly when the app is a set member; lazily registered otherwise). Canonical eager order = surfaces first, then services (dock, launcher, notifications, keyboard, clipboard, promptd, portal, polkit).
